name: evaluation-brief
title: Evaluation brief
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM evaluations ORDER BY code

sections.title: Agreed acceptance criteria
sections.sql: SELECT name,mandatory,expected,status,evidence,reviewer,reviewed_on FROM criteria WHERE evaluation_id=$1 ORDER BY name

sections.title: Product gaps
sections.sql: SELECT feature,owner,due_date,blocking,status,evidence,resolution FROM gaps WHERE evaluation_id=$1 ORDER BY due_date

name: decision-record
title: Technical decision record
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM evaluations ORDER BY code

sections.title: Decision
sections.note: A technical win records an internal decision. It is not a customer acceptance signature or a revenue forecast.

sections.title: Evidence history
sections.sql: SELECT action,actor,detail,created_at FROM audit WHERE evaluation_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at,id
